title: Fixed-Effect Saturation Is Not Weak Identification: Certifying Inference under Measurement Error
abstract: arXiv:2608.06053v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fixed-effect saturation alone is not weak identification. In the baseline model, fixed-effect--residualized OLS is unbiased and conventional inference is asymptotically exact at every level of residual treatment variation $\tau^2=nQ_K>0$: unlike a weak first stage in IV, a small $\tau^2$ produces no size distortion by itself. Classical measurement error in the treatment changes this. Under a local noise drift $\sigma_\nu^2=c^2/n$, the FE-OLS $t$-statistic converges to a non-central normal whose non-centrality $\eta$ falls with $\tau^2$ and, once the within reliability $\lambda$ is held apart from the fixed-effect dimension $\rho$, is $\rho$-free: saturation rescales the whole problem by $\sqrt{1-\rho}$ rather than preferentially destroying signal or noise. translated_title: 固定效应饱和并非弱识别：测量误差下的推断认证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.06053v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：固定效应饱和本身并非弱识别。在基线模型中，固定效应残差化OLS估计是无偏的，且常规推断在残差处理变异水平 $\tau^2=nQ_K>0$ 的每个水平上渐近精确：与IV中的弱第一阶段不同，小的 $\tau^2$ 本身不会产生尺寸失真。处理中的经典测量误差改变了这一结论。在局部噪声漂移 $\sigma_\nu^2=c^2/n$ 下，FE-OLS t统计量收敛于非中心正态分布，其非中心参数 $\eta$ 随 $\tau^2$ 减小，并且一旦将组内可靠性 $\lambda$ 与固定效应维度 $\rho$ 分开，$\eta$ 就与 $\rho$ 无关：饱和通过 $\sqrt{1-\rho}$ 重新缩放整个问题，而非优先破坏信号或噪声。将由此产生的尺寸失真求逆，可得到 $\tau^2$ 的闭式Stock-Yogo式临界值，而常规推断失效时的可靠性阈值具有明确的解析形式。
tldr: 本文证明固定效应饱和不会导致弱识别，但在测量误差下会扭曲推断，并提供了闭式临界值和可靠性阈值来校准推断失效条件。
en_tdlr: This paper shows fixed-effect saturation does not cause weak identification, but measurement error distorts inference, providing closed-form critical values and reliability thresholds for when conventional inference fails.
